onboarding.title: Registration Form
onboarding.businessNameHint: This will be used to register your account and will appear on receipts generated from the POS terminal.
onboarding.storeAddressHint: Your store address will be displayed on receipts
onboarding.eftposIntegration: Do you need an EFTPOS terminal with Tyro integration?
onboarding.eftposHint: We currently integrate with Tyro Eftpos terminals. Select 'Yes' if you'd like to integrate or register with Tyro, and we'll contact you to assist with the process.
onboarding.alipayPayment: Do you plan to enable Alipay / WeChat Pay?
onboarding.alipayOpen: I don't have an account and would like to open one
onboarding.readyByHint: If your service includes on-site setup and menu configuration, we typically require 2 weeks lead time before deployment. Large custom hardware orders may require additional time.
onboarding.menuUploadHint: If your menu or product list is ready, please upload it in PDF, Word, or Excel format.
onboarding.multipleFilesNote: Note: You can upload multiple files
onboarding.menuContactInfo: No worries if you're not ready yet. When available, please provide it at least 1-2 weeks before POS terminal deployment. Send to purchasing@pospal.com.au or via your preferred method (e.g., WeChat) to your account manager.
onboarding.heardAbout: How did you hear about us?
onboarding.heardSaw: Saw our POS at another store
onboarding.termsAgreed: I agree to the terms and conditions
